text: Japan's October core inflation rose to 2.2%, its highest in 2026, while headline inflation reached 2.3%. Following September's energy subsidy expiry, energy prices rose 2.2% and gas prices 5.8%. Core-core inflation declined from 2.4% to 2.2%.

meta.note: Reported December subsidy reinstatement and anticipated monetary tightening are not realized policy changes.

text: Anthropic's underwriters exercised the full 147 million-share overallotment, bringing IPO proceeds to $93.5 billion. A concurrent $26 billion private placement brought aggregate gross proceeds to $119.5 billion. Shares declined 12% in Friday premarket trading.

meta.note: Aggregate gross proceeds include the private placement and exclude offering expenses.
